title: Stakeholder-advocate path-brief template (engage-chorus)
description: Slot template the primary agent fills before dispatching each stakeholder advocate.

situation.description: Restated negotiation + decision at stake (from Step 0).

otherStakeholders.description: Role identifiers of the other N-1 stakeholders — names only, no characterization, to keep the advocate focused on its own role.

userSuppliedDocuments.description: Optional list of user-supplied document references the advocate may reference inline (contract drafts, position papers, prior emails).
